name: cbaruba.org
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: www.cbaruba.org scores 63 out of 100 (D). 8 checks fail now, 29 are at risk, and 26 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 193 elements on /, /contact-and-opening-hours/, /site-map/, for example a[title="Home"] and a[title="Contact us"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /contact-and-opening-hours/, /site-map/, for example button. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Form elements must have labels
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /contact-and-opening-hours/, /site-map/, for example #searchText. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 94 elements on /site-map/, for example #siteMap > .level1.menu > .Aboutus.firstItem > a[title="About us"] and #siteMap > .level1.menu > .Home > a[title="Home"][href="/"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (2 requests), and cookies _gid, _gat_UA-2011291-9, _ga_4YSJ4F5KCW, _ga.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Every page has a meta description
